priorityList: Trinket Usage: Use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Black Arrow whenever available; anticipate casting it immediately after every Rapid Fire.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff would expire before you could finish an Aimed Shot cast.
Activate Trueshot for an instant Black Arrow proc and use it immediately.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus and Aimed Shot cooldown reduction.
Every single Precise Shots proc must be spent.
Follow up every Aimed Shot with a Multi-Shot on 2+ targets to spend Precise Shots procs.
Follow up every Rapid Fire with a Multi-Shot on 2+ targets (depending on Talents) to spend Precise Shots procs.
